SHIONTHEBRUISER-DEFENSIVE.description: Blocks your [gold]Berserk[/gold] and [gold]Galvanised[/gold] effects for the rest of the turn. Can't be played in a turn where one of them triggered.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DEFENSIVE.title: Defensive
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NONNATIVE.description: Cards from other characters, or Colorless cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NONNATIVE.title: Non-Native
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STALE.description: Doesn't offer any advantages when upgraded.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STALE.title: Stale
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LATENT.description: Shuffled to the end of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] at the start of each combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LATENT.title: Latent
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALDPOWER.description: When played, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL your other [gold]Emerald Powers[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALDPOWER.title: Emerald Power
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMBLAST.description:
Starts each combat set aside. Once the [gold]Team Blast[/gold] gauge is full, add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of each turn.
When played, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL other [gold]Team Blasts[/gold] of ALL players. Only one [gold]Team Blast[/gold] can be used per combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMBLAST.title: Team Blast
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BERSERK.description: Gains additional effects while your HP is at or below [blue]50%[/blue] of your Max HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BERSERK.title: Berserk
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NOVEL.description:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Random[/gold].
Remove [gold]Novel[/gold] on ALL identical cards.
Afterwards, [gold]Novel[/gold] can't be applied on identical cards this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NOVEL.title: Novel
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLIMY.description: After playing this card, add a [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLIMY.title: Slimy
SHIONTHEBRUISER-VERYSLIMY.description:
After playing this card, add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Counts as [gold]Slimy[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-VERYSLIMY.title: Very Slimy
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GALVANISED.title: Galvanised
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GALVANISED.description: Gains additional effects while you have at least the specified amount of [gold]Vigor[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COOLDOWN.title: Cooldown X
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COOLDOWN.description:
This card has [gold]Retain[/gold]. When played, it returns to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and is free to play for X turns.
If played during those X turns, it is discarded with no additional effect.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-REQUEST.title: Request X
SHIONTHEBRUISER-REQUEST.description: ALL effects of this card following [gold]Request X[/gold] trigger at the start of your turn in X turns (immediately when the counter reaches [blue]0[/blue]).
SHIONTHEBRUISER-REFUSE.title: Refuse X
SHIONTHEBRUISER-REFUSE.description: For the next X turns, do not trigger your [gold]Damage Debt[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-VALKYRS.title: The Valkyrs
SHIONTHEBRUISER-VALKYRS.description: The Valkyrs' effects are not affected by any of your modifiers.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WOUNDING.title: Wounding
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WOUNDING.description: When played, add a [gold]Wound[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-ERRATIC.title: Erratic
SHIONTHEBRUISER-ERRATIC.description:
When you draw this card, randomize its cost from [blue]0[/blue] to [blue]3[/blue].
Removes [gold]Unplayable[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLOODBEND.title: Blood Bend X
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLOODBEND.description: Consumes ALL your [gold]Blood[/gold] and converts it into X for the effect of the card.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GAMBLE.title: Gamble X
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GAMBLE.description:
Choose X cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add [gold]Erratic[/gold] to them this combat and put them on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Statuses and Curses can be chosen.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMUP.title: Team-Up
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMUP.description:
Played by two players. When you play it, each ally of the named class adds an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy into their [gold]Hand[/gold].
Its effect happens when one of them plays that copy. Their other copies are [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
